title: Why Gas Prices Feel So Expensive

scenes.narration: Have you noticed your wallet getting lighter every time you fill up?

visual.text: Why Gas Prices Feel So Expensive

scenes.narration: Since January 2000, while general consumer inflation rose 99%, regular gas prices surged 222%.
Fuel costs are rising much faster than the price of your everyday goods.
The full story is on the channel.

title: The Brutal Truth About Oil Spikes

scenes.narration: Why do gas prices jump so aggressively year after year?

visual.text: The Brutal Truth About Oil Spikes

scenes.narration: Over the last year alone, crude oil surged by 66.2% to reach $100 per barrel.
This volatility ripples directly from global oil markets to your local station.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Gas Prices: A 30 Year Look Back

scenes.narration: Do you remember when gas was barely over a dollar?

visual.text: Gas Prices: A 30 Year Look Back

scenes.narration: Back in August 1990, gas averaged $1.22 per gallon.
Today, that price has climbed 241%, standing at $4.15 per gallon.
